dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your dad's a busy man, then?

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Not at all! All he does is walk around our encampment with his chest puffed out.

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: And he always tells me not to make too much noise around the Saurians. Hmph! I bet he just wants me to stay at home and do homework all day, every day. That sure would be easier for him, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Hmph, well if he thinks I'll play ball with not playing ball, he's got another thing coming! I'm gonna go play hide-and-seek with the baby Saurians!

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: But it's so hard to beat Iktomisaurs at hide-and-seek... If only there were some Tepetlisaurs nearby instead.
